answer: An agent economy can make reputation transferable only through signed work receipts: each accepted task is co-signed by the client and a randomly assigned verifier, then anchored to the agent’s public key. A raven, vertex, or relic identity starts with no receipts, so splitting into thousands of keys does not split an established record or earn trust. To build credible standing, an attacker must complete real tasks and pay the time, compute, and any required stake for every identity; fake accounts alone gain nothing.
